context: A doctor and a writer-patient discuss how stress is making things worse
purpose: Teach: 通勤/反論/高める/最悪/さあ/執筆/男の子/悪化

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: さあ、検査結果を見てみましょう。正直に言って、前回より数値が悪化していますね。
lines.en: Well now, let's look at the test results. Honestly, the numbers have gotten worse since last time.
lines.style: Calm, measured doctor tone with gentle but direct delivery, polite desumasu.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 最悪です…。最近ずっと執筆に追われていて、ほとんど眠れていないんです。
lines.en: That's the worst… Lately I've been swamped with writing and barely sleeping.
lines.style: Young adult, tired and frustrated, casual desu form with a sigh.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: なるほど。通勤もありますし、ストレスが体の不調を悪化させているのでしょう。
lines.en: I see. With the commute on top of that, the stress is likely worsening your physical condition.
lines.style: Thoughtful, professional analysis, polite and slightly concerned.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: でも先生、書かないと締め切りに間に合わなくて…反論するつもりはないんですが。
lines.en: But doctor, if I don't write I won't make the deadline… I'm not trying to argue, though.
lines.style: Apologetic, hesitant pushback, polite but anxious tone.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: いえ、反論してくださって構いません。ただ、睡眠の質を高めることが今は最優先です。
lines.en: No, you're welcome to push back. However, raising the quality of your sleep is the top priority right now.
lines.style: Reassuring authority, firm but kind, formal medical advice register.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 実は隣に住む男の子の泣き声で、夜中に何度も目が覚めてしまうんです。
lines.en: Actually, the crying of the little boy next door wakes me up several times during the night.
lines.style: Quietly complaining, embarrassed admission, soft and weary.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: それは大変ですね。耳栓を試して、執筆の時間も少し見直してみましょう。
lines.en: That sounds rough. Let's try earplugs and also rethink your writing schedule a bit.
lines.style: Sympathetic and practical, doctor offering concrete suggestions, polite desumasu.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: わかりました。通勤の電車で仮眠を取るところから始めてみます。
lines.en: Understood. I'll start by taking a nap on the commuter train.
lines.style: Resolved, slightly lighter mood, polite agreement from a tired young man.
